name: K-S2
description: Where the white of the far terrain in the solo pictures comes from (the owner's second symptom of 2026-11-15: the distant mountain range of the cb_far picture is a flat bright white silhouette; the baseline picture of K-S1 with every layer empty already shows it, so the cloud pass does not draw it). One start on the pad with the own cloud pass drawing (Medium, the owner's 2560x1440 at UI_SCALE 1.5, raytracing off, frame generation off, EVE removed). SurfaceProbe opens the viewer, holds the vessel and the clouds, sets K-S1's universal time (1470283.6; else K-S1's sun search for 45 degrees), places K-S1's cb_far pose (300 m, elevation 5, a cell 60 km ahead) at heading 90 (pose p1, K-S1's: the camera looks at the sun, 0 degrees from it in K-S1's log) and at heading 270 (pose p2) and takes the same frame several times at one frozen time, changing ONE thing: old_fog (the fog rule before the package: the field's visibility is the fog's under a forced level, driver.forcedLevelOwnsFog 0), baseline (the rule now, every layer empty), drawn (the cell alone), no_weather (weatherEffects off: the writer, the weather field, the pass), no_pass (ownClouds off), no_cover (groundCover off), no_atmo (Atmospheres' master switch off: the main mod's own settings, Scatterer, TUFX and the game's air stay); p1 takes all seven, p2 baseline, drawn and no_atmo. Each frame logs 'surface: <pose>_<frame>: fog ...' (RenderSettings.fog, mode, density, colour, ambient, the sun's light, what the fog writer holds, the weather view's level and visibility, the field's level at the vessel, the camera and its angle to the sun, the sun's elevation, the UT); the pictures are compared offline (tools/surface_frames.py): luminance, chroma and local contrast of the far terrain across the frames. The probe judges the sameness of the frames (the layer alone, the camera did not move, the sun did not move, the two headings look at the sun from angles 60 degrees apart) and that the fog rule took effect and each picture is written, not the look. At most 15 minutes of scenario. Rows: tests/series/rows/SURFACEPROBE.json.

starts.description: Five frames of one pose and one sun (SurfaceProbe, module order 993) at 2560x1440, UI_SCALE 1.5. About 4 to 6 minutes after the flight is up.
